end.parentNote: Krish practised English names for farm animals and animal sound words. They used prompts to work through several names and gave “quack” for duck. They also said sheep makes “baa” and identified rooster; no mix-up was recorded as needing later correction. At home, use animal picture cards and ask Krish to name each animal and match it with its sound.
